Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 105: January 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #105 shipped to subscribers in December 2009 (bearing the cover date of January 2010 for Issue 105). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #105 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, bonus video features, and exclusive media previews:

Bayonetta (stylish third-person action hack-and-slash)
Guitar Hero: Van Halen (rhythm music game)
Need for Speed: Shift (racing simulation)
NBA 2K10 (sports simulation)
CSI: Crime Scene Investigation: Deadly Intent (mystery adventure)
South Park: Let's Go Tower Defense Play! (Xbox Live Arcade tower defense)
Tower Bloxx Deluxe (Xbox Live Arcade casual puzzle strategy)
Inferno Pool (Xbox Live Arcade arcade physics pool)
Rainbow Islands: Towering Adventure! (Xbox Live Arcade action platformer)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, a 20-minute Sam & Max video spectacular featurette, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Splinter Cell: Conviction, Halo: Reach, and Mass Effect 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
